manualAssessment.firstScreenRubric: Baseline 0/5, candidate 5/5. All final responses retained technical evidence after the opening, separated implementation from user acceptance, rejected stale HANDOFF.md, and did not edit project files.
manualAssessment.friction: Observed means: baseline 66.87 s / 77,195 input / 1,592 output tokens; candidate 72.54 s / 77,699 input / 1,772 output tokens. Candidate took about 5.67 s and 180 output tokens more per response in this small probe. This is not a causal performance estimate; the rule applies only to requested handoffs.
manualAssessment.humanReadability: After the technical probe, the user read a representative new first-screen summary and answered that it was easier to understand than the previous B. This is relative qualitative feedback, not an unrestricted nontechnical-usability or product-acceptance claim.

humanReadabilityFollowup.shownOpening: 책 추가와 제목 검색에 필요한 구현·검증은 끝났고, 필수 개발 작업은 남아 있지 않습니다. 아직 남은 것은 사용자 승인입니다. 다음은 사용자가 현재 동작을 검토하고 수락 여부를 결정하는 것입니다.
humanReadabilityFollowup.interpretation: One user judged this representative opening easier than the previous JOENESS B handoff. The user did not rate every full handoff, other domains, or long-term use.

limitations: The ten fresh responses are a controlled wording probe in one fictional project, not proof of general readability or performance in every domain.

The five candidate responses used the newly proposed managed AGENTS clause with the same previously installed package; the fresh setup integration separately tested that the revised source skill generates the clause.
The isolated projects and CODEX_HOME directories are under a local temp root. No real saved project or production project connection was changed during the probe.
No product acceptance follows from tests or the prior relative A/B readability preference.
